newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices steady, rain hurts output.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices steady, rain hurts output.

text.p: Indian castorseed September delivery prices on Monday held steady in a narrow range at 1,139/1,140 rupees per quintal amid limited activity, dealers said.
"Fresh offerings remained low at the lower level following reports of a drop in the arrivals due to unseasonal rains at producing centres," a dealer said.
Fresh bull buying too remained slow due to the absence of fresh overseas buying, dealers said.
Groundnut oil held steady at 358/359 rupees per 10 kg amid limited arrivals while physical buying remained at a low ebb.
Imported palm oil was down by 1/2 rupees at 276/277 rupees per 10 kg on fresh arrivals at the Bombay port coupled with sliding global prices.
In Rajkot spot groundnut oil moved up by 3/4 rupees at 563/564 rupees per 15 kg amid lower summer crop arrivals due to unseasonal rains in the Gujarat region.
